'''Reina Ueda''' (Japanese: '''上田麗奈''' ''Ueda Reina'') is a Japanese voice actress for {{aniseries|PTS}}. She is also a singer from her own separate career. 

==Biography==
Ueda was born on January 17, 1994 in {{wp|Toyama Prefecture}}, {{wp|Japan}}, and became a voice actress and singer as an adult. She joined {{aniseries|PTS}} during {{aniseries|SM}}, where she gained two notable roles: {{an|Mallow}}, one of {{ashcl|Ash's classmates}}; and [[Snowy]], {{an|Lillie}}'s Pokémon. Ueda is currently affiliated with the talent agency {{wp|81 Produce}} and won the Best Rookie Actress award during the {{wp|9th Seiyu Awards}} in 2015.
